key_findings: Insular cortex axons evoke monosynaptic EPSCs of comparable amplitude in glutamatergic (including PBN-projecting) and GABAergic/glycinergic Sp5C laminae I/II neurons, while local inhibitory connections onto excitatory neurons show high failure rates.
Chemogenetic activation of IC terminals in the Sp5C lowers mechanical and thermal nociceptive thresholds, indicating that IC projections facilitate excitatory Sp5C output to the parabrachial nucleus.
